newsitem.title: USA: Wall St stocks seen rising at open.
newsitem.headline: Wall St stocks seen rising at open.

text.p: U.S. stocks are expected to push higher at Wednesday's opening, a day after the Dow Jones industrials finally managed to close over the 5900-point level.
Blue chips had met with stubborn resistance in several previous runs at the marker and their success yesterday seemed to spark renewed interest in U.S. stocks.

"Yesterday's rally carried over into London," said Larry Wachtel, market analyst at Prudential Securities. "It looks like we'll have a fairly good open and now it's a matter of internal dynamics and whether we can carry it forward."
